import { test, expect } from "bun:test";
test("cause", () => { throw new Error("outer msg", { cause: new Error("inner msg") }); });
test("props", () => { const e: any = new Error("with props"); e.fixture = { hiddenFixtureKey: "fixture-secret-value" }; throw e; });
test("nostack", () => { console.error("^"); console.error("LOGGED_FIXTURE_DATA {\"k\":\"secretlogged\"}"); const e = new Error("nostack err"); e.stack = "nostack err"; throw e; });
test("nonerror obj", () => { console.error("^"); console.error("LOGGED2 secret2"); throw { plain: "object thrown secret3" }; });
test("null throw", () => { console.error("^"); console.error("LOGGED3 secret4"); throw null; });
test("timeout", async () => { console.error("LOGGED4"); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); }, 50);
test("aggregate", () => { throw new AggregateError([new Error("agg1"), new Error("agg2")], "agg outer"); });
test("assertions", () => { expect.assertions(2); expect(1).toBe(1); });
test("strlong", () => { expect("line one\nline two with secret\nline3").toBe("line one\nline two diff\nline3"); });
test("route", () => { expect("/api/projects/create").toBe("/api/projects/list"); });
